adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the handler explicitly allows non-organizer actors (`isAttendee` / team admin/owner) to add guests, but it constructs `EventManager` using `getUsersCredentials(ctx.user)` and spreads `user` (the acting user) into the EventManager context. Meanwhile, the booking query eagerly includes `booking.user.credentials`, but those credentials are never used. This makes it verifiable from the diff that calendar updates via `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` will run under the acting user's credential set rather than the organizer/booking owner's, which can prevent updating the organizer's calendar event when the actor is not the organizer.
